info.description: Generated from the API route schemas by `pnpm gen:api`. Do not edit by hand.

mfaEnabled.description: Whether sign-in asks for an authenticator code.

activeTenant.description: Null until a user with several hospitals picks one.

policy.description: Null when there is no active tenant.

needsPassword.description: False when this person already has an account: they only accept.

secret.description: Base32, for typing into an authenticator by hand.

recoveryCodes.description: One-time codes. Returned this once and never again.

primary.description: Brand colour as six-digit hex. Must read as text on a white background (contrast of at least 4.5:1); the web app falls back to its default colour otherwise.

logoUrl.description: https or same-origin URL of the hospital logo (SVG or WebP, at most 50 kB).

features.description: Module flags. A module that is absent is off.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: A session with no activity for this long ends. The web app warns shortly before and signs the user out. Absent means the app default.

status.description: A suspended hospital keeps its data but its staff cannot use the app. Tenant-scoped routes answer 403 tenant_suspended.

Invite.description: An invitation that has been emailed. The link is not returned.

StaffMember.description: Someone who works at the hospital, or has been invited to. For a member `id` is the user id; for an invitation it is the invitation id.

StaffPage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

PatientSummary.description: A patient as shown in a list: compact, no clinical data.

phone.description: Masked to its last four digits for a caller without patient.contact:read.

PatientPage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

PatientRecord.description: A registered patient with the details captured at registration. Email and address are left out for a caller without patient.contact:read.

phone.description: Masked to its last four digits for a caller without patient.contact:read.

version.description: Goes up by one each time the record changes. Send it back as expectedVersion when changing the record.

PatientUpdate.description: The version the change is based on, and the fields to change. Null clears an optional field. The MRN never changes.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the record the change was made from. If the record has changed since, the request is refused with 409 conflict and nothing is changed.

PatientDuplicateMatch.description: A possible duplicate, masked by the server: enough to recognise the person, not to read their details. No id.

Department.description: A department of one hospital. Holds no patient data.

version.description: Counts the changes. Sent back as expectedVersion.

DepartmentPage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

Doctor.description: A doctor profile: a staff member of one hospital, in one department. Holds no patient data.

active.description: False once the doctor no longer practises here, or while their membership of the hospital is deactivated: kept on old records, not offered for new ones.

version.description: Counts the changes. Sent back as expectedVersion.

DoctorPage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

consultationMinutes.description: The usual length of one appointment.
The usual length of one appointment.

DoctorCandidate.description: A user who works at the hospital and has no doctor profile there. The email tells namesakes apart; nothing else of the account is given.

DoctorCandidatePage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

DoctorAvailability.description: Regular weekly working hours. A day without a session is a day off.

ServicePrice.description: What a service costs on one price list from one date. A price is never edited: a new one takes over from its own date.

amountMinor.description: In the minor unit of the hospital's currency.

effectiveFrom.description: A calendar date at the hospital.

effectiveTo.description: The last day it applies. Absent while no later price follows.

ServicePricePage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

Its name, category and tax class can be changed, and a charge keeps what they were when it was posted: changing them never changes an old bill. `currentPrice` is the price in force today on the standard list, absent when there is none.

taxClass.description: Which tax rate applies, as a class. The rate of each class is the hospital's tax setting, so a change of rate does not touch the services.

version.description: Counts the changes. Sent back as expectedVersion.

ServicePage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

priceMinor.description: In the minor unit of the hospital's currency.

taxClass.description: Which tax rate applies, as a class. The rate of each class is the hospital's tax setting, so a change of rate does not touch the services.

cursor.description: Opaque. Pass the nextCursor of the previous page.

archived.description: True lists the archived services instead of the active ones. Absent: false.

get.description: The active hospital of the session and its configuration. Private per session, never CDN-cached.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: Signs in with email and password and starts a session, returned as an httpOnly cookie. Every failure of the email and password has the same answer, 401 invalid_credentials. An account with an authenticator answers 401 mfa_required until the request also carries `code`, and 401 invalid_mfa_code when the code is wrong.

code.description: Authenticator code, or a recovery code. Only for accounts that have one.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: Ends the session, on the server and in the browser. Succeeds whether or not there was one.

get.description: Bootstraps the app in one request: the signed-in user, the active tenant with its config, and the effective access policy. Private per session, never CDN-cached. Session routes ignore X-Tenant-ID, so a stale tab can always reload its session.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: Rebinds the session to another hospital the user belongs to and returns the new session. Affects every tab.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: What the invite screen shows before the person accepts: which hospital, which email, and whether a password has to be chosen. The token is in the body, not the URL, so it is not logged.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: Accepts an invite. Someone new sets their password here (400 password_required without one). Someone with an account needs only the token. The link works once. The person then signs in.
Emails a reset link if the address has an account. The answer is the same either way, so it cannot be used to find accounts.

204.description: Done, whether or not an email is sent

post.description: Sets a new password with a reset link. The link works once. Every session of the user ends.
Starts setting up an authenticator app and returns its secret. Sign-in does not change until a code is confirmed. Calling it again before that starts over.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: Finishes setup with a code from the authenticator. From now on sign-in asks for a code. Returns the recovery codes, once.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: Replaces the recovery codes. Needs the password and a code from the authenticator itself.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: Removes the authenticator and its recovery codes. Needs the password and a current code.

get.description: Whether the active hospital requires an authenticator of its staff (its `mfa` and `mfa_required` switches are both on). A user for whom this is true and whose `mfaEnabled` is false is refused every route of the hospital with `mfa_required` until one is set up.

200.description: Default Response

get.description: The effective access policy for the active tenant. Supports ETag and If-None-Match so a refresh is cheap. Returns 409 tenant_mismatch when X-Tenant-ID differs from the session tenant.

200.description: The current policy

get.description: Liveness check. The process is running.

200.description: Default Response

get.description: Readiness check. The process can reach its database.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: Invites someone to the active hospital in one of its roles and emails them a single-use link. A newer invite to the same address replaces an older one. The role may hold nothing the caller does not hold: 403 role_not_allowed otherwise.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client. Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again.

201.description: An invitation that has been emailed. The link is not returned.

get.description: The people of the active tenant, by name: its members, or the invitations it has sent that are still open. `q` matches the name or the email address. The hospital is the session's. `total` comes with the first page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque. Pass the nextCursor of the previous page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Which people: active members (when left out), deactivated members, or open invitations.

200.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

get.description: The roles of the active tenant that the caller may invite someone into, by name: those whose permissions are all held by the caller's own role, so an invitation never grants more than the inviter has (POST /invites refuses the others with 403 role_not_allowed). Ids and names only: what a role may do belongs to role management.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: Deactivates someone's membership of the hospital: every session they have there ends at once, the open invitations they sent are withdrawn, and they cannot work there until reactivated. Their account and their memberships of other hospitals are untouched, and the membership is kept, never deleted. 409 cannot_deactivate_self for the caller's own membership, 409 last_admin when no other active member could manage staff. Doing it twice changes nothing. Nobody acts above themselves: a member whose role holds a permission the caller's role does not is refused with 403 role_not_allowed. Someone who is not a member of the hospital answers 404 staff_not_found, the same as a user that does not exist.

200.description: Someone who works at the hospital, or has been invited to. For a member `id` is the user id; for an invitation it is the invitation id.

post.description: Makes a deactivated membership active again, in the role it had. Doing it twice changes nothing. Nobody acts above themselves: a member whose role holds a permission the caller's role does not is refused with 403 role_not_allowed. Someone who is not a member of the hospital answers 404 staff_not_found, the same as a user that does not exist.

200.description: Someone who works at the hospital, or has been invited to. For a member `id` is the user id; for an invitation it is the invitation id.

post.description: Ends every session the person has at this hospital, so they must sign in again to work here: the sessions bound to it are revoked (`revoked` counts them), and a session they have at the hospital picker or at another hospital can no longer be brought here. Their work at other hospitals carries on. For the caller's own account only the sessions bound here are ended, and the current one is kept. Nobody acts above themselves: a member whose role holds a permission the caller's role does not is refused with 403 role_not_allowed. Someone who is not a member of the hospital answers 404 staff_not_found, the same as a user that does not exist.

200.description: Default Response

delete.description: Withdraws an open invitation: its link stops working. For an address that was wrong, since inviting again only sends the same address a new link. An invitation that is not open here (accepted, withdrawn, expired, another hospital's, unknown) answers 404 invite_not_found. The caller must be allowed to give its role (403 role_not_allowed).

post.description: Patients of the active hospital, one cursor page at a time. The search term travels in the body, never in a query string, because it can be a name, a phone number or an MRN. Every word of the term must appear in the name or MRN, in any order; a term that looks like a phone number is also matched against phone numbers for a caller who holds patient.contact:read. It reads data only. `total` is given on the first page.

q.description: Search text: name, phone or MRN.

cursor.description: Opaque. Pass the nextCursor of the previous page.

200.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

post.description: Finds existing patients who may be the same person as one about to be registered, across the whole hospital. The identifying details travel in the body, never in a query string. Matches are masked and carry no id. It reads data only.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: Registers a patient in the active hospital and assigns the MRN. The Idempotency-Key header is required: a retried or double-submitted request returns the first result instead of a second patient. A replay answers with the id only; read the record to show it. The server records when and by whom contact consent was captured.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client. Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again.

201.description: A registered patient with the details captured at registration. Email and address are left out for a caller without patient.contact:read.

get.description: One patient of the active hospital, with the details captured at registration.

200.description: A registered patient with the details captured at registration. Email and address are left out for a caller without patient.contact:read.

patch.description: Changes registration details of a patient. expectedVersion is the version the caller read: if the record has changed since, the answer is 409 conflict and nothing is changed. Only the fields sent are changed; null clears email or address. The MRN and the hospital never change. Sending a contactConsent that differs from the one on record records the new decision with the time and the caller. Values the record already has change nothing.

200.description: A registered patient with the details captured at registration. Email and address are left out for a caller without patient.contact:read.

get.description: Departments of the active tenant, by name. Archived departments are listed only when asked for. `total` comes with the first page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque. Pass the nextCursor of the previous page.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: True lists the archived departments instead of the active ones.

200.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

post.description: Adds a department. The hospital is the session's: the body carries no tenant. A name already used by a department of the hospital, archived or not, whatever its capitals, is refused with 409 department_name_taken.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client. Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again.

201.description: A department of one hospital. Holds no patient data.

patch.description: Changes a department. Send the version the change was made from: 409 conflict when the department has changed since, 409 department_name_taken for a name in use. Sending what the department already has changes nothing. A department of another hospital answers 404 department_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: A department of one hospital. Holds no patient data.

post.description: Archives a department: it stays on the records that name it and is no longer offered for new ones. Doing it twice changes nothing. A department of another hospital answers 404 department_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: A department of one hospital. Holds no patient data.

post.description: Brings an archived department back. Doing it twice changes nothing. A department of another hospital answers 404 department_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: A department of one hospital. Holds no patient data.

get.description: Active staff members of the active tenant who have no doctor profile yet, by name: who a profile can be created for. `q` matches the name or the email address. Staff are users, not patients.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque. Pass the nextCursor of the previous page.

200.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

get.description: Doctors of the active tenant, by name. `q` matches the name or the specialization. `total` comes with the first page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque. Pass the nextCursor of the previous page.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: False lists the doctors who are no longer active instead.

200.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

post.description: Gives a staff member of the hospital a doctor profile. The hospital is the session's: the body carries no tenant. 409 doctor_exists when that person already has one, 400 when the user is not an active member or the department is not an active department of the hospital.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client. Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again.

201.description: A doctor profile: a staff member of one hospital, in one department. Holds no patient data.

get.description: One doctor. A doctor of another hospital answers 404 doctor_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: A doctor profile: a staff member of one hospital, in one department. Holds no patient data.

patch.description: Changes a doctor profile, or makes it inactive or active again (active again only for someone who is still an active member, 400 otherwise). A new department must be an active department of the same hospital (400 otherwise). Send the version the change was made from: 409 conflict when the profile has changed since. Sending what the profile already has changes nothing. A doctor of another hospital answers 404 doctor_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: A doctor profile: a staff member of one hospital, in one department. Holds no patient data.

get.description: A doctor's regular weekly working hours, in the hospital's timezone. Scheduling reads this. A doctor of another hospital answers 404 doctor_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: Regular weekly working hours. A day without a session is a day off.

put.description: Replaces the weekly working hours. Sessions of one day must not overlap and each must end after it starts (400 otherwise); a session ends by 23:59 of its own day, so one cannot run past midnight. 409 conflict when the hours have changed since the version sent. Sending the hours the doctor already has changes nothing. A doctor of another hospital answers 404 doctor_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: Regular weekly working hours. A day without a session is a day off.

get.description: The price lists of the active tenant, the standard one first. Every hospital has one standard list; others (for a payer or a room class) come later.

200.description: Default Response

post.description: The services the active tenant can charge for, by name, each with the price in force on its standard price list today, where today is the date at the hospital in its own timezone. Every word of `q` must be in the code or the name, in any order. Archived services are listed only when asked for. It reads data only. What is searched for travels in the body, never in a query string: the same search is made from prescribing, ordering and billing screens while a patient record is open, and a search term beside a patient id in an access log is patient data. The API does not log the body. `total` comes with the first page.

200.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

post.description: Adds a service. The hospital is the session's: the body carries no tenant. The code is the service's identity on bills and cannot be changed later; one already used by a service of the hospital, archived or not, whatever its capitals, is refused with 409 service_code_taken. `priceMinor`, when given, is its price on the standard list from today.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client. Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again.

201.description: Something the hospital can charge for. Holds no patient data. Its name, category and tax class can be changed, and a charge keeps what they were when it was posted: changing them never changes an old bill. `currentPrice` is the price in force today on the standard list, absent when there is none.

get.description: One service, with the price in force today on the standard list. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: Something the hospital can charge for. Holds no patient data. Its name, category and tax class can be changed, and a charge keeps what they were when it was posted: changing them never changes an old bill. `currentPrice` is the price in force today on the standard list, absent when there is none.

patch.description: Changes a service: its name, category, tax class or description, never its code. Send the version the change was made from: 409 conflict when the service has changed since. Sending what the service already has changes nothing. A price is not changed here: see the prices of a service. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: Something the hospital can charge for. Holds no patient data. Its name, category and tax class can be changed, and a charge keeps what they were when it was posted: changing them never changes an old bill. `currentPrice` is the price in force today on the standard list, absent when there is none.

post.description: Archives a service: it stays on the charges and bills that name it and is no longer offered for new ones. Doing it twice changes nothing. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: Something the hospital can charge for. Holds no patient data. Its name, category and tax class can be changed, and a charge keeps what they were when it was posted: changing them never changes an old bill. `currentPrice` is the price in force today on the standard list, absent when there is none.

post.description: Brings an archived service back. Doing it twice changes nothing. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

200.description: Something the hospital can charge for. Holds no patient data. Its name, category and tax class can be changed, and a charge keeps what they were when it was posted: changing them never changes an old bill. `currentPrice` is the price in force today on the standard list, absent when there is none.

get.description: The prices of a service on a price list, newest first: the one in force, those before it and any that is scheduled. Without `priceListId` the hospital's standard list. A withdrawn price is not listed. `total` comes with the first page. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist. A `priceListId` must be a price list of the session's own hospital: any other, known elsewhere or not, answers 404 price_list_not_found.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque. Pass the nextCursor of the previous page.

200.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

post.description: Gives a service a new price from a date. Prices are never edited, and a charge already posted keeps the price, the tax class and the category it was posted with. The first price of a service may start today at the hospital (its timezone) or later. Once a price is in force, a new one starts tomorrow or later, never today: charges posted this morning used the price that was in force. The price in force then ends the day before the new one starts. At most one price is scheduled at a time: while one is, a second is refused with 409 price_date_conflict until it is withdrawn. An archived service takes no new price (409 service_archived). The service is locked while this is worked out, and an exclusion constraint keeps the periods of a service on a list from overlapping whatever the code does. A `priceListId` must be a price list of the session's own hospital: any other, known elsewhere or not, answers 404 price_list_not_found. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value (such as a UUID) chosen by the client. Repeating the request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing the work again.

201.description: What a service costs on one price list from one date. A price is never edited: a new one takes over from its own date.

delete.description: Withdraws a price that has not come into force yet: the price before it stays in force with no end date. A price that is or was in force cannot be withdrawn (409 price_in_force): it is history, and the database refuses it too. A price that is not of this service or hospital, or was withdrawn already, answers 404 price_not_found. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.
